solver_message:
Updated `scenes/main.tscn` with `Level/CoinHighlights` and six circular `Polygon2D` children named `CoinHighlight1` through `CoinHighlight6`.

Each highlight has a tight 14-pixel radius and 35% opacity. Rendered in Godot 4.4.1 and visually verified that all six align with their yellow star coins.
